profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I possess extensive expertise as a Software Engineer and Software Architect, backed by a considerable number of years devoted to designing multi-tiered and service-oriented distributed applications. My experience encompasses proficiently architecting highly scalable applications and developing reusable application block frameworks, employing Test-Driven Development (TDD) and agile methodologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design, development and deployment of Azure Workflow Services (Workflows for SharePoint Online) using Azure DevOps.
Delivering highly scalable Workflow solutions on top of Azure platform.
Support infrastructure and application incidents.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Design, development and deployment of Azure Workflow Services (Workflows for SharePoint Online) using Azure DevOps.

positions.title: Cloud Solution Architect
positions.description:
Conduct architecture design sessions on Azure Cloud Services such as Kubernates, Service Fabric and App Services.
Collaboration with partners and sales team to ensure partner enablement and drive business growth through results.
Drive the deployment of the customer workloads into Azure and increase their consumption of the platform by providing design and deployment guidance to the partners.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
